name: structured-query-v1-golden
description: The frozen golden corpus of contract mavi-query-v1 (ADR-024). tools/verify_repo.py validates every query against contracts/schemas/structured-query-v1.schema.json (schemaValid is the expected verdict; a refusal the schema cannot state is schemaValid true). The .NET tests parse every query and evaluate each case with a setup against the SceneAnalyticsWorld fixture over HTTP. Placeholder ids map to the fixture; the unknown placeholder maps to nothing. setup: none (refused by the parser, or no data read), derived (scene facts committed, events derived), underived (facts committed, events not yet derived), pending (scene facts not committed), two-camera (derived plus a second camera with no scene, recorded three and a half hours earlier, with two Vehicle Tracks starting at one instant). expect.envelope is the normalised envelope: fixture ids as their placeholders, any other id as <id>, snapshot and fingerprint left out.
